app_startup.text: Iter Viae Navis online. Map artifacts detected. Try to stay on the road for once.

gps_acquired.text: GPS location acquired. We know where you are, so no excuses.

trip_loaded.text: Operation route {trip_title} loaded. Total distance {total_miles} miles. Let's see if we survive this.

turn_left.text: In {distance}, turn left onto {street_name}. Use your turn signal.

turn_right.text: In {distance}, turn right onto {street_name}. Pay attention.

continue_straight.text: Continue straight on {street_name} for {distance}. Just drive forward, it's not complicated.

u_turn.text: Make a U-turn when safe. Yes, you went the wrong way.

highway_exit.text: In {distance}, take exit {exit_number} towards {destination}. Don't miss it.

off_route.text: Great job, wrong turn. Recalculating since you clearly can't follow a simple arrow.

arrived_waypoint.text: Arrived at waypoint {waypoint_name}. We're stopping here for {stay_duration} minutes.

destination_reached.text: Target destination {destination_name} reached. We actually made it. Try not to trip on your way out.

refuel_warning.text: Warning: Tank's getting low. Stop being cheap and find a gas station unless you enjoy pushing 4,000 pounds of metal.

lodging_warning.text: You've been driving for 8 hours. You're exhausted and dangerous. Find a hotel nearby.
